title: Esses write-ahead journal entry (journal-1)
description: One <Project>/.journal/<seq>.json file of the write-ahead autosave (02 section 6.8, D-019, D-070): the full canonical document of every project file that was dirty at the autosave, with the hash of the on-disk file the edit started from (null for a new file) and the hash of the document's canonical bytes. seq is monotonic in the folder; replay takes the newest entry per path ordered by seq, then at. Unknown top-level members are allowed and preserved; entries are closed.

$schema.description: Schema id (D-072). The urn:esses: form is written; the bare esses: form of earlier drafts and the later https form are accepted on load and normalised on save (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

schemaVersion.description: Minor version within major 1 (02 section 6.6 rule 1).

path.description: Project-relative path with '/' separators, inside the project folder (no '.' or '..' segment, no ':' or '\\').

baseHash.description: xxh3-128 of the on-disk bytes the edit started from; null for a new file.

hash.description: xxh3-128 of the document's canonical bytes.

document.description: The full document (validated by its own schema on recovery).

hash128.description: xxh3-128 as "xxh3:" + 32 lower-case hex digits, high word first (Hash128::hex()).

isoDateTime.description: ISO 8601 date-time with seconds and a UTC offset (or Z).

legacyBag.description: Fields removed by a migration, kept verbatim (02 section 6.6 rule 3).
